{{raw-eggs}}

==Ingredients==
* 8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] semi-sweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
* ¾ stick of [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Rum|rum]]

==Procedure==
# Mix by hand. Cream butter with sugar then add egg yolks and finally the rum. Soften the chocolate in a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]] (don't let the inner pan touch the water in the outer pan) or a microwave. 
# Combine the melted chocolate with butter mixture, and beat with a spoon for about 5 minutes.
# Refrigerate overnight.
# Form into balls using a plastic bag as a mitt. Roll the balls in chopped nuts or chocolate sprinkles, powdered sugar, or anything else. 
# Store in refrigerator.

== See also ==
* [[Cookbook:Rum balls]]
